48016.meaning1: depending on powerful people; relying on the powerful

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, mahācoro balavanissito hoti? idha, bhikkhave, mahācoro rājānaṃ vā rājamah'āmattānaṃ vā nissito hoti.

so vata, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ime pañca āvaraṇe nīvaraṇe cetaso ajjhāruhe paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe pahāya, balavatiyā paññāya att'atthaṃ vā ñassati par'atthaṃ vā ñassati ubhay'atthaṃ vā ñassati

48019.meaning1: I am strong; I am powerful; I am mighty

examples.text: yadapi, bhikkhave, lobho tadapi akusalamūlaṃ, yadapi luddho abhisaṅkharoti kāyena vācāya manasā tadapi akusalaṃ, yadapi luddho lobhena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto parassa asatā dukkhaṃ uppādayati vadhena vā bandhanena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā pabbājanāya vā balav'amhi bal'attho iti'pi tadapi akusalaṃ.

48020.meaningLit: I am powerful, power is good
48020.commentary: (ANa) balav'amhī'ti aham'asmi balavā. bal'attho iti'pī'ti balena me attho iti'pi, bale vā ṭhito'mhī'ti'pi vadati.

examples.text: yadapi luddho lobhena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto parassa asatā dukkhaṃ uppādayati, vadhena vā bandhanena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā pabbājanāya vā balav'amhi bal'attho iti'pi tadapi akusalaṃ.

48025.meaning1: strength and might; power and heroism
48025.commentary: (SNa) balavīriyan'ti ettha balaṃ nāma vāyodhātu, vīriyaṃ kāyikacetasikavīriyam'eva.

examples.text: issattaṃ balaviriyañ'ca, yasmiṃ vijjetha māṇave, taṃ yuddh'attho bhare rājā, n'āsūraṃ jātipaccayā.

48026.meaning1: strength and willpower; power and determination
48026.commentary: (MNa) balavīriyan'ti apar'āparaṃ sañcaraṇavāyodhātu, sā parihāyī'ti attho. (SNa) balavīriyan'ti ettha balaṃ nāma vāyodhātu, vīriyaṃ kāyikacetasikavīriyam'eva.

examples.text: tesaṃ gimhānaṃ pacchime māse, tiṇ'odakasaṅkhaye, adhimattakasimānaṃ patto kāyo hoti. tesaṃ adhimattakasimānaṃ pattakāyānaṃ balavīriyaṃ parihāyi.
so kho ahaṃ, aggivessana, oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āhāretvā, balaṃ gahetvā, vivicc'eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.

48028.meaning1: species of brown crane; family of crane
